verdict.rationale: No first-party doc describes bulk operations. Community hands-on reports do confirm the engine has batch indexing: one user sent 1,000,000 records, a 7M-article import ran via memory-intensive batch indexing, and an 80M-document self-hoster says batch indexing fixed their throughput problems. One report notes indexing of 50k constantly changing records fell behind, which limits confidence in bulk updates. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk add/update/delete endpoints, bulk delete-by-filter or bulk edit operations, and evidence of bulk operations through the MCP/AI interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: later releases plus batch indexing fixed it
